name: FB Dashboard | Complete Customers, Companies & Locations [DISABLED]

parameters.content: DISABLED DEVELOPMENT WORKFLOW. Full customer and B2B company directory. Requires read_customers or read_companies, the approved Shopify OAuth credential, and the Flavour Blaster Supabase service-role credential. Never activate or backfill without separate approval.

nodes.name: Merge Customer State and Shopify Response

parameters.jsCode: const b=$('Normalize Complete Customers').item.json;const pagesRead=b.pagesRead+1;const more=Boolean(b.pageInfo?.hasNextPage);if(more&&pagesRead>=b.maxPages)throw new Error('SHOPIFY_CUSTOMERS_PAGE_LIMIT_REACHED:'+b.maxPages);if(more&&!b.pageInfo?.endCursor)throw new Error('SHOPIFY_CUSTOMERS_CURSOR_MISSING');return [{json:{runStartedAt:b.runStartedAt,end:b.end,after:more?b.pageInfo.endCursor:null,page:b.page+1,maxPages:b.maxPages,pagesRead,customersRead:b.customersRead+b.customers.length,continue:more}}];
